title: Missing moeb tool: Read (tool-result output file reader)
description: Used the Claude Code Read tool to read tool-result output files saved to absolute temp paths (e.g. C:\Users\...\tool-results\mcp-moeb-start_spec-*.txt and *.json). These files are written by the harness when MCP tool output exceeds inline limits. No moeb tool exists for reading files by absolute path outside the project working directory.
proposed_resolution: Add a read_tool_result moeb tool that accepts an absolute path and returns the file content, subject to the same size cap as read_file. Alternatively, extend read_file to accept absolute paths when the path is within a known harness session directory.
